verification_report.summary: The proof is correct. It constructs a maximum-length nonempty trail using finiteness and the existence of an edge; proves that trail is closed by an incidence-parity argument at its terminal vertex, correctly counting loops twice; and then uses connectedness to find an unused edge incident with the trail if any edge were omitted. Cyclically rotating the closed trail and appending that edge contradicts maximality. Every hypothesis is appropriately used, and there are no external references or prohibited proof patterns.
